newsitem.title: USA: Matria to cut staff, CEO to resign.
newsitem.headline: Matria to cut staff, CEO to resign.

text.p: Matria Healthcare Inc said on Tuesday that as part of its restructuring to complete the March merger of Tokos Medical Corp and Healthdyne Maternity Management, President and Chief Executive Robert Byrnes would step down at year-end.
Tokos Medical and Healthdyne announced plans to merge last year and and Matria is the new company.

Matria said it would cut more field and corporate staff by the year end, as a final step in its merger consolidation. Due to these and other restructuring steps, Matria said it would take charge of about $7.5 million in the fourth quarter.
These actions were expected to reduce Matria's projected annual operating expenses by about another $5 million per year, the company said.

Matria also said it was forming a search committee to find find a new CEO as soon as possible. Until a successor was named, Chairman Parker Petit and Donald Millard, senior vice president of finance, would jointly act as company president.
Byrnes had been the chairman and chief executive officer of Tokos, and became president and CEO of Matria after the merger, the company said.
